description: Build nextjs-automation-saas starter - Workflows and scheduled jobs with Clerk, Neon/Drizzle, Inngest, and Stripe
steps: Create nextjs-automation-saas/ directory with .gitignore

Create package.json with exact-pinned deps: next@15.3.4, react@19.0.0, react-dom@19.0.0, @clerk/nextjs, drizzle-orm, stripe, inngest, pg. DevDeps: typescript@5.8.3, vitest@3.2.1, fast-check@3.23.2, eslint@9.28.0, eslint-config-next@15.3.4, tailwindcss@4.1.10, @tailwindcss/postcss@4.1.10, postcss@8.5.4, drizzle-kit, @types/pg, @types/node, @types/react, @types/react-dom

Create starter.json matching catalog entry (id:7, choices:Inngest, technologies:[TypeScript, Clerk, Neon, Drizzle, Inngest, Stripe], auth:Clerk, data:Neon + Drizzle, monetization:Stripe, integrations:[Inngest])

Create drizzle/schema.ts with tables: workflows (id, userId, name, description, triggerType enum [manual,scheduled,webhook], isActive, createdAt, updatedAt), triggers (id, workflowId, type, config jsonb, createdAt), runs (id, workflowId, triggeredBy, status enum [pending,running,completed,failed,cancelled], startedAt, completedAt, error, createdAt), stepAttempts (id, runId, stepName, attemptNumber, status enum [pending,running,succeeded,failed], startedAt, completedAt, error, createdAt), subscriptions (id, userId, stripeCustomerId, stripeSubscriptionId, stripePriceId, status enum [active,past_due,cancelled,trialing], currentPeriodEnd, cancelAtPeriodEnd, maxRunsPerMonth, createdAt, updatedAt), processedEvents (id, providerEventId unique, eventType, processedAt). Include drizzle/migrations/ with initial SQL.
Create drizzle.config.ts
Create domain/entities.ts with types for Workflow, Trigger (TriggerType), Run (RunStatus), StepAttempt (StepStatus), Subscription (SubscriptionStatus), ProcessedEvent

Create domain/policies.ts with: AuthContext (userId), canCreateWorkflow (authenticated + under plan limit), canEditWorkflow (workflow owner), canTriggerRun (workflow owner + active subscription + under monthly run limit), canViewRun (workflow owner). Deny-by-default with plan gating.

Create lib/server/config.ts with ConfigSpec for: CLERK_SECRET_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, DATABASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, INNGEST_EVENT_KEY, INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Create lib/server/errors.ts with AppError, BillingError, WebhookVerificationError, PlanLimitError, RetryExhaustedError, sanitizeProviderError
Create lib/server/auth.ts with Clerk adapter
Create lib/server/billing.ts with BillingPort and StripeAdapter with HMAC webhook verification for subscription events
Create lib/server/billing-fake.ts with FakeBillingAdapter
Create lib/server/jobs.ts with JobPort interface (triggerWorkflow, getRunStatus) and InngestAdapter. Implement bounded retry with configurable maxAttempts and terminal failure state.
Create lib/server/jobs-fake.ts with FakeJobAdapter that simulates run lifecycle: pending -> running -> completed/failed with bounded retries
Create lib/server/database.ts with Drizzle client
Create lib/server/providers.ts
Create middleware.ts protecting /dashboard with Clerk
Create app/page.tsx - public landing page describing workflow automation
Create app/dashboard/page.tsx - protected dashboard (create/manage workflows, view runs, plan status)
Create app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts - verified Stripe subscription webhook
Create app/api/inngest/route.ts - Inngest serve endpoint for workflow functions
Create next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, postcss.config.mjs, vitest.config.ts
Create .env.example
Create tests/unit/domain/policies.test.ts testing plan gating and ownership
Create tests/unit/server/billing.test.ts
Create tests/unit/server/jobs.test.ts testing bounded retry and terminal failure
Create tests/integration/workflow.test.ts testing create workflow + trigger run flow
Create tests/integration/auth.test.ts
Create tests/property/auth-consistency.test.ts (Property 4)
Create tests/property/webhook-authenticity.test.ts (Property 5) for Stripe webhook
Create tests/property/retry-termination.test.ts (Property 8) - for any maxAttempts, runs terminate after that many failures
Create tests/smoke/build.test.ts
Create README.md documenting workflows, Inngest setup, retry behavior, Stripe billing, deployment
Run pnpm install, lint, typecheck, test, build
acceptance_criteria: nextjs-automation-saas/ directory exists with all required files
pnpm install succeeds with committed lockfile
pnpm lint, typecheck, test, build all pass
Property 4, 5, and 8 tests present and passing
Inngest job adapter has fake with bounded retry simulation
Plan gating: subscription limits monthly runs
Terminal failure recorded after retry exhaustion
